tasks.subject: Task 3: Auto-pause detector
tasks.description:

**Files:**

- RunCore/Tests/RunCoreTests/AutoPauseDetectorTests.swift

**Acceptance Criteria:**
- [ ] Pauses at 36 s and resumes at 63 s
